resale_co.how_to_apply: No Township resale CO or CCO for residential sales. The only Township item for a home sale is the smoke detector / carbon monoxide certificate from the Bureau of Fire Inspections (see fire certificate).

evidence.quote: EHT does NOT require CCO Inspections for residential resales or rentals.
Egg Harbor Township does NOT require a resale Certificate of Occupancy (CO) or Continued Certificate of Occupancy (CCO) for residential property transfers or residential rental properties.
Egg Harbor Township does not conduct resale inspections through the Construction Office.
Pat J. Naticchione Construction Official ... Phone: 609-926-4122 Fax: 609-926-4003

resale_co.notes: The Township says in writing (notice signed by Construction Official Pat Naticchione, March 2026, re-read 2026-10-06) that it does not require a resale CO or CCO for residential transfers or rentals. A $200 Continued Certificate of Occupancy application exists only for limited cases: voluntary requests, commercial mercantile licenses, and residential work done without permits. The same notice reminds sellers that the smoke/CO certificate from the Bureau of Fire Inspections is still required. The Construction Official's email is hidden behind an email-protection link and decodes to BuildingInspections@ehtnj.gov.

requirements: Built 1978 and before: 10-year sealed battery smoke alarms on each level and outside each separate sleeping area
Built 1979 to 1987: hard-wired alarms near each sleeping area and in the basement; 10-year sealed battery alarms can be added for the other levels
Built 1988 to 1991: hard-wired, interconnected alarms on each level and outside each sleeping area
Built 1991 to present: hard-wired interconnected alarms with battery backup in all bedrooms, outside each sleeping area and on every level
Carbon monoxide alarm near the sleeping area(s), UL 2034 listed
Choice of a notarized owner affidavit or an on-site inspection request

authorities.how_to_apply: Download the 'Smoke Cert. - Property Resale / Residential Tenant' affidavit from the Document Center. Either fill out the whole form as a notarized owner affidavit, or fill out only the top portion to request an on-site inspection. Submit it with the fee to the Bureau of Fire Inspections, 3515 Bargaintown Road, Egg Harbor Township, NJ 08234 (fax 609-926-4181). Office hours Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 4:30 pm; no payments after 4:15 pm.

fire_cert.notes: The Township is the fire code enforcing agency for the whole township (registry code M); the volunteer fire companies do not issue resale certificates. The Fire Inspections page gives one fee, $54.00; the affidavit prints $54, $90 and $161 without saying which timing tier each belongs to (they line up with the state's more than 10, 4 to 10 and under 4 business-day tiers, but the form does not say so). The Document Center now links a re-uploaded copy of the affidavit (April 24, 2026, 'Smoke Cert. - Property Resale / Residential Tenant', same wording as the October 2025 copy, which is still posted at the Fire Inspection folder link). The page email decodes to fireinspections@ehtnj.gov; the affidavit lists tnaylor@ehtnj.gov (Tammy Naylor, Clerk 1) and the state directory lists Bcummings@ehtgov.org. The affidavit no longer lists a fire extinguisher (in line with P.L.2025, c.19), but the Fire Inspections page title and the March 2026 Construction Office notice still mention it.
